findings.title: Current progress summaries disagree with confirmed latest review
findings.evidence: Confirmed94.5kg/99cm in Progress and weekly history; Journey Now95kg/waist100cm and Life Back95kg/100cm after reload.
findings.action: Resolve latest confirmed measurement consistently without rewriting immutable starting values.

findings.title: Progress to Fit changes URL without changing visible panel
findings.action: Synchronise route, selected tab and visible panel; verify without reload.

findings.title: One Programme still exposes competing baseline and next-step flows
findings.evidence: Journey asks reason again; Journey Life Back says Set your baseline despite actual54/100. Today also offers a separate one-question coaching start alongside existing Next Shift.
findings.action: Reuse saved reason and Life Back state; define one primary member action and how weekly Journey, Programme reviews and coaching relate.

findings.title: Meal planner needs nutrition-quality acceptance
findings.evidence: Fast3day plan showed3meals on day3 totalling861.2kcal/person and no fibre totals. Snacks/drinks are explicitly excluded.
findings.action: Review full-day plan balance and intended completeness/targets with appropriate nutrition owner; do not imply the audit establishes clinical adequacy.
